source_name: IKAF — Institute of Certified Accountants and Finance, Kosovo, Konkurs pune
why_relevant: Second Kosovo accountancy body publishing Albanian-language vacancies, including project-funded finance/expert roles; complements SCAAK for coverage of the finance-professional labour market that donor projects draw on.

source_name: UNGM — United Nations Global Marketplace tender notices (Kosovo)
why_relevant: Consolidated venue for UN-system (UNDP, UNOPS) tenders and individual-consultant calls covering Kosovo, including economic-governance and financial-management assignments not visible on TED or ECEPP.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës (SHBK / Kosovo Banking Association) — Board of Directors page
why_relevant: Names the chair, vice-chair and each board seat of the national banking association. Board seats are held ex officio by bank CEOs, so a change on this page is a near-real-time signal of a CEO change at a Kosovo commercial bank.

source_name: SHBK — Anëtarët / Member Banks directory
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of every commercial bank operating in Kosovo (Banka Ekonomike, BKT, Banka për Biznes, Credins, Isbank, NLB, PriBank, ProCredit, Raiffeisen, TEB...). This is the seed actor list from which all bank-level career pages, leadership pages and hiring feeds are derived.

source_name: SHBK — Periodiku Bankar (banking periodical, PDF series)
why_relevant: The association's periodical carries bank-by-bank news pages that routinely announce new CEOs, board appointments and departmental reorganisations, plus signed articles that reveal who holds which functional role (payments, cards, digital) inside each member bank.

source_name: SHBK — official Facebook page
why_relevant: Albanian-language mirror of association announcements, often posted before the website is updated; useful redundancy given the site's 403 behaviour.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — Board of Governors
why_relevant: The American Chamber's Board of Governors is elected annually by the General Assembly and typically includes bank and fintech executives; each election produces a dated, attributable list of named executives and their employers.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — Committees (incl. Financial Services & Investment Climate Committee)
why_relevant: Committee chairs and members are named executives from banks, PSPs, insurers and vendors — a direct 'who leads what functional agenda' map. The Finance / Financial Services committee is the single most on-topic body for this cell.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — tiered member directories (Patron / Corporate / Medium / Small)
why_relevant: Four tiered directories enumerate hundreds of companies active in Kosovo including banks, insurers, IT vendors and consultancies. Tier is itself a crude size/spend signal, and the directory is a ready-made vendor/partner actor list for the payments ecosystem.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — Newsroom / vacancies
why_relevant: Carries the annual General Assembly election stories that name incoming governors and their institutions, plus AmCham's own vacancy notices — a small but clean jobs signal for the association layer.

source_name: STIKK — Kosovo ICT Association, About / Board of Directors
why_relevant: Publishes a full named board (chair, deputy chair, members) with company and job title for each, plus the executive team. Board turnover is visible between terms — search snippets showed a materially different roster (Burbuqe Hashimi chair) from the current page (Astrit Leti chair), confirming this page is actively updated and diff-worthy.

source_name: STIKK — News and ICT Sector Data / Publications
why_relevant: STIKK publishes ICT labour-market and skills reports plus news of member company expansions and hiring programmes — the closest thing to a sector-wide hiring barometer for tech talent that banks and PSPs compete for.

source_name: AMIK — Shoqata e Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare të Kosovës, Komitetet (committees)
why_relevant: Unusually granular: AMIK lists Finance, Legal & Compliance, HR and Marketing committees with named individuals and their employing MFI (e.g. KEP Trust, Kos Invest, KRK). This maps functional middle management across the non-bank lending sector — exactly the layer that is invisible on corporate websites.

source_name: AMIK — Anëtarët e AMIK (member MFIs directory) and Governance
why_relevant: Enumerates the licensed microfinance institutions and NBFIs in Kosovo — the second tier of credit providers alongside the banks, and a distinct hiring market. The Governance page names the board and executive director (Shpresim Vranovci, ED since 2022).

source_name: AMIK — Pozicionet dhe Komunikatat për Media
why_relevant: Association position papers and press releases signed by named officers; historically used to announce sector-wide responses and leadership statements, which attributes roles to individuals with a date.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike Gjermano-Kosovare / Kosovarisch-Deutsche Wirtschaftsvereinigung (OEGJK / KDWV)
why_relevant: The German-Kosovar chamber elects a board at its annual Kuvend; the current board is chaired by Eriola Bibolli (a bank CEO), which makes this chamber a direct crossover point between the banking sector and the German business community. Board elections are reported with full named slates.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (OEK / Kosovo Chamber of Commerce) — Kryesia
why_relevant: The statutory national chamber (founded 1962) publishes its Kryesia (presidency) and sectoral structures. Chamber presidency elections are contested and covered in the press, giving dated leadership events; the chamber also hosts sector groupings that include financial services.

source_name: OEK — Konkurset (vacancy and call notices)
why_relevant: Chamber-hosted vacancy notices, including calls for chamber officer positions themselves — a small but clean, dated jobs feed at the association layer, and occasionally used by member companies.

source_name: SCAAK — Shoqata e Kontabilistëve të Çertifikuar dhe Auditorëve të Kosovës (governance + members)
why_relevant: Professional body for accountants/auditors with a 7-member elected board published per term (e.g. 2024-2026), plus a members register and 'subjektet e asociuara' (associated firms). CFOs and finance directors of banks and PSPs circulate through this board, making it a leadership-move source for the finance function specifically.

source_name: IKAF — Instituti i Kontabilistëve, Auditorëve dhe Financierëve të Kosovës
why_relevant: Rival/complementary professional institute claiming ~5,000 registered professionals (external auditors, accountants, internal auditors, valuers). Its register and CPD event listings surface named finance professionals and their employers across the banking sector.

source_name: European Cluster Collaboration Platform — STIKK organisation profile
why_relevant: EU-run registry profile of STIKK giving an independently maintained description, contact person and membership scale — useful as a cross-check on association self-reported figures and as a discovery route to other Kosovo clusters/associations listed on the same platform.

source_name: Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije (komorakim.rs)
why_relevant: Serbia-aligned chamber for Kosovo and Metohija — a parallel association structure with its own officers and member companies serving the Serb-majority north, invisible to Pristina-based directories. Provides the Serbian-language half of the actor map required by this run's language scope.

source_name: Privredna komora Srbije — Kosovo-related entrepreneur associations / parlament privrednika
why_relevant: PKS registers entrepreneur associations from Serb-majority Kosovo municipalities and seats their representatives in its parliament of entrepreneurs, so its registries and board pages name Kosovo-based business figures under a Serbian institutional frame.

source_name: STIKK — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Posts announce new board terms, member joins and ICT hiring programmes; STIKK also amplifies member-company vacancy campaigns, which is the fastest read on tech hiring intensity around the banking vendor ecosystem.
